request.style: English, hardcore punk, very fast drums, buzzsaw guitars, a hoarse shouted male lead and a crowd shouting back, short and furious, 160 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees
Hypocrites
You tithe your mint and dill and cumin
And neglect the weightier things

[Chorus]
Whitewashed tombs, whitewashed tombs
Beautiful outside, dead men's bones within
Whitewashed tombs, whitewashed tombs
Justice and mercy and faithfulness

[Verse]
Blind guides, you strain out a gnat
And swallow a camel
You clean the outside of the cup
But inside full of greed

[Chorus]
Whitewashed tombs, whitewashed tombs
Beautiful outside, dead men's bones within
Whitewashed tombs, whitewashed tombs
Justice and mercy and faithfulness
